title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Unusable Days Credited on Traded-Vehicle Cancellations
content:
For a traded-vehicle refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, days of the term the holder could not use are credited.

| How the contract was sold | Days credited |
|---|---|
| On a purchase deal delivered after the contract's sale date (delivery date from the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records) | the days from the sale date to the delivery date |
| On its own, with no purchase deal | the coverage level's waiting-period days: 30 at Kessler Shield Powertrain, Powertrain Plus, Select, Preferred, Exclusionary and Exclusionary Wrap alike |
| Otherwise | none |

**Examples (hypothetical).**
- A deal delivered 4 days after the contract's sale date: 4 days.
- A contract sold on its own: 30 days.
- A deal delivered on the sale date: 0 days.
